supervisor_summary: Chipotle at $30.90 trades at 23.5x NTM consensus EPS against a re-verified 21.88x consistent restaurant-peer median, and no premium is justified as persistent. The round-2 convergence (fair values $30.5-31.9) is mostly anchoring on my round-1 inputs, and one of those inputs was wrong: the $1.57B TTM free cash flow that four agents used as their DCF base includes ~$0.3B of one-off H1-26 tax and working-capital inflows (10-Q / 8-K cash-flow statement). On a normalized ~$1.28B after-SBC 2027 FCF, my reconciled fair value is $29.6, about 4% below the price, and I shift the 12-month ladder median down ~3% to ~$29.8. The Q3 print on Oct 28 is inside the 1-month window and is a two-sided event with no edge; every company figure the agents rely on (comps +2.2%, RLM 25.2%, 4,186 units, 1,265.4M shares, $775M cash) checks out against the filings.
key_drivers: Q3 2026 print on 2026-10-28: comp vs the ~+1% guide (which assumes ~200bp of cyclospora drag, excludes the August salmonella episode, and laps the year's toughest compare, +0.3%) and the Q4-to-date update.

Free cash flow is lower than the TTM suggests: TTM $1.57B includes ~$0.3B of one-off H1-26 tax and working-capital inflows, and capex stays elevated through 2027 ($834.1M 2026 guide). Normalized 2027 FCF is ~$1.36B before SBC (~$1.25-1.30B after), a ~3.3% yield on the $39.1B market cap.

Restaurant-level margin: 25.2% in Q2 (-220bp); the Q3 guide implies ~23.9% (estimate: 100 - 29.9 cost of sales - 25.5 labor - 15.5 other opex - 5.2 occupancy held at the Q2 level; occupancy is not guided); pricing (mid-2%) is guided to match ~3% inflation only from Q4; ground beef +9.6% YoY (Aug-26) but USDA sees 2027 steer prices roughly flat with 2026.

Unit growth and buybacks: ~335-360 company-owned openings in 2026 (the 350-370 guide includes 10-15 partner-operated); ~60% year-2 cash-on-cash; diluted shares -5.3% YoY, but H1 buybacks ($1.33B) exceeded H1 FCF ($0.93B) and cash fell to $775M, so buybacks must slow to about FCF (~3%/yr net).

Multiple: 23.5x NTM vs a 21.88x consistent peer median; FY27 growth (+19.1%) is a rebound and matches WING/TXRH at the median, so no premium is justified; the 10Y at 5.31% caps both the multiple and the DCF.
